description: Free threat-intelligence checks for Claude: screen links for phishing and malware, assess crypto wallet risk, score suspicious emails, and look up data breaches. Link, wallet, and email checks need no API key.
name: io.github.nzdsf2-gif/relayshield-free-mcp

tools.description: Checks one URL, or up to 25 URLs in a single call, against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus for known phishing, malware, and scam abuse.
tools.name: check_link

tools.description: Returns a read-only risk assessment of a cryptocurrency wallet address. It never moves funds or initiates transactions.
tools.name: check_wallet

tools.description: Scores a suspicious email for phishing signals from its parsed fields.
tools.name: check_email

tools.description: Checks whether an email address appears in known data breaches. Read-only: it only looks up breach records.
tools.name: check_breach

relayshield_api_key.description: Enables the breach-check tool. Leave empty to use the link, wallet, and email checks keyless.
relayshield_api_key.title: RelayShield partner API key (optional)
